name: Myask
source:
Department of Computer Sciences; Gray cat

A student skilled at hacking. Has a rather unique way of speaking.

An undergrad student whose hacking skills are as extraordinary as her way of speaking. However, there are rumors that her dialect disappears when she gets serious.
